1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.d4 exd4 5..strategy: Trades off the knight that attacks d4, with tempo, since the capture also attacks the queen. White removes the target before the bishop defends e4 and forces Black to double the c-pawns, a structural concession that ...d5 can later repair.
Recaptures towards the centre and keeps the queens on, which the other recapture would not. The doubled c-pawns are a weakness, but Black gets an open b-file and can undouble them with ...d5.
